name: Xu Yuan Packaging Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xu Yuan Packaging Technology Co., Ltd., a company based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, specializes in the global manufacturing and distribution of various plastic packaging materials. Established in 1993, its primary focus is on heat-shrinkable films and tube-sleeving plastics. The company offers a comprehensive range of packaging products, including diverse shrinkable films, multi-layered films, and pouches. Their specialized label solutions feature PET, PVC, and OPS shrink labels. Furthermore, they supply associated machinery like shrink labeling machines, automatic label shrinking equipment, and label inserting systems. Complementing their packaging materials and labeling machines, Xu Yuan also manufactures and supplies shrink tunnels, reel handling systems, and precision-engineered components, including polyformaldehyde, iron, and aluminum CNC parts, along with rectifiers. Beyond packaging, the company's diverse activities encompass the production and retail of molds, the wholesale distribution of various chemicals, and the sale of sleeve (sticker) labeling machines and vibrant shrink labels. They are also involved in the manufacturing and wholesale of general plastic products and related industrial machinery, as well as the assembly of spare parts, grinding machines, and large industrial beds. Xu Yuan extends its services to include technical consultation, product design, and international trade operations. Their solutions are widely adopted across numerous industries, such as food and beverages, transparent product packaging, pharmaceuticals, personal care, and for creating secure cap seals and tamper-evident features.
